_comment: v1.6.0 (v1.5.9 base) — Section 09 executive films (one slot per card). Source of truth for scripts/v1.4.7/build.mjs (copies assets/<person>/ → dist/assets/exec/films/<person>/), dist/build-info.json (films[]), features/exec-films/exec-films.js (window.AtharExecFilms) and the QA suite. status: 'shipped' = file verified and served · 'coming-soon' = labelled ready slot, no file served. To ship a film later: drop the files into assets/<person>/, fill the entry, set status to shipped, run the build. burnedInSubtitles: whether the film itself carries burned-in captions (the <track> VTTs are shipped either way).

khalid.usedInsteadOf: the _v2 file (~109.23 MB) was not found anywhere (media library, uploads, prior artefacts, deployment zips, repo history); the best verified file is the media-library master athar-origins-of-impact-ep01-muhammed-khalid_1080p_subtitled.mp4 (id 6abe166ad64782b8259834dc, 40.000 s, sha256 c7c20005…3ab2a) in its v1.5.6 trim (closing end card removed at frame 896 / 37.333 s) — the committed 1080p source below

source.note: 1080p source kept in the repo (45,357,475 B; 1920×1080 24 fps H.264 High 9.45 Mb/s + AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo, faststart, burned-in English subtitles); master provenance in sources/khalid/SOURCE.md

khalid.mp4MobileNote: 1280×720 transcode of the 1080p source (libx264 High@4.0 crf 23, AAC 128k, +faststart) for viewports ≤ 720 px and Save-Data
khalid.posterNote: frame at 00:09.100 — the only caption-free window in the transcript (between cues c03 08.800 and c04 09.400; the film carries burned-in English subtitles everywhere else). The film has no frame that is guaranteed free of its own title typography; chosen by transcript timing + pixel heuristics, not by eye. Replaces the v1.5.6 poster at 00:15.5, which showed the name title card under a burned-in caption.

captions.note: WebVTT, 12 cues each, generated from the burned-in English subtitles (EN) and translated (AR); cues sit at line:6% so they never cover the burned-in text

khalid.v160: retained unchanged in v1.6.0: the library search found NO '_v2' 1080p subtitled Khalid film — the 1 Oct master (this file's source) is the only one; a separate 4K master (athar-origins-of-impact_4K-master_v2.mp4, 3840x2160, 40 s, 71,354,505 B, library id 6ac1289e28a9b41edb0c1866, 2026-10-03T16:09Z) exists but was not requested for the card and is not used; shipped file sha256 re-verified by the build gate
